explanation.headline: Octreotide acetate is not on FDA's shortage list; one registered plant for a labeled product was classified OAI on 2026-04-17

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include octreotide acetate as of 2026-10-21.
FDA inspection 1321638 at that plant ended on 2026-04-17 and was classified OAI, with the classification known on 2026-07-16.
The same plant received a Warning Letter on 2017-03-10 and prior OAI classifications in 2016 and 2022.
Current inventory across three Corvale sites ranges from 17.2 to 25.6 days on hand for the 500 ug/mL, 1 mL presentation.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

rejected.text: A product label for octreotide acetate 500 ug/mL, 1 mL vial lists USV Private Limited (FEI 3004086192) as the manufacturing and packaging plant.
rejected.reason: number 500 is not in the cited evidence

memory.text: Decision on carboplatin: move the primary carboplatin contract from Accord to Teva and keep Accord as secondary. Rationale: Accord's supplier plant had an FDA warning letter; Teva supply steadier (demo history). Approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD.

Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
